note: AGE-RESTRICTED: adult-only community (children under 18 may stay two weeks at most). Park near Largo, 7 mi from the Gulf beaches (formerly Lee's Travel Park); some full-timers but takes transient nightly/weekly/monthly stays. No buses, pop-ups, tents, truck campers or vans; campers must be self-contained. --Claude
